description: This file defines an abstract base class for handling configurations and request/response transformations related to Anthropic messages within a language model framework. It includes abstract methods for validation, URL construction, request transformation, and response handling, as well as optional methods for signing requests and streaming responses.

classes.name: BaseAnthropicMessagesConfig
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for configuring, transforming, and managing Anthropic message requests and responses.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,Optional[str]] validate_anthropic_messages_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[Any], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates the environment for the Anthropic message request, returning headers and optional API base URL.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs and returns the complete request URL, potentially incorporating the model into the URL.

methods.name: list get_supported_anthropic_messages_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported parameters for the given model.

methods.name: Dict transform_anthropic_messages_request( self, model: str, messages: List[Dict], anthropic_messages_optional_request_params: Dict, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms messages and parameters into a request dictionary suitable for sending.

methods.name: AnthropicMessagesResponse transform_anthropic_messages_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms a raw HTTP response into an AnthropicMessagesResponse object.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,Optional[bytes]] sign_request( self, headers: dict, optional_params: dict, request_data: dict, api_base: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, stream: Optional[bool] = None, fake_stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Signs or modifies request headers as needed before sending.

methods.name: AsyncIterator get_async_streaming_response_iterator( self, model: str, httpx_response: httpx.Response, request_body: dict, litellm_logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Provides an asynchronous iterator over streaming responses; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: "BaseLLMException" get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Creates and returns an error object based on response status and message.
